changes.title: Damage after equipment questions with evidence
changes.text: Choose an equipment occurrence and an explicit following-turn window. See exactly how the question was interpreted, then inspect the anchor and contributing public hero damage records. Observed totals remain lower bounds, and missing historical events are never invented.

changes.title: Recorded window, persistence and native evidence regressions
changes.text: Verify actual binary recording through reload, querying, visible Android results and exact evidence. Cover boundaries, run identity, incomplete observations, overflow, persistence and timing/storage; retain all existing checks.

changes.title: Connected investigation milestone
changes.text: I started the five-capability checklist and the first connected question-to-evidence milestone. The larger timeline, experiments and progress work remains in progress. I preserved existing saves, outcomes and recorded history.

changes.title: Saved hotbar positions remain authoritative on resume
changes.text: Starting Waterskin preferences now apply only to new runs. Existing manual item positions, unassigned slots, placeholders and saved custom layouts are preserved when resuming. Manual edits at the hero-ready boundary also save immediately through the existing safe save path rather than waiting for app pause.

changes.title: Focused APD Settings categories
changes.text: Use a compact category index, consistent smaller controls and clear timing descriptions. All existing settings remain available; recording diagnostics and technical details are in Advanced.

changes.title: Atomic completed seed-replay state
changes.text: A completed seed replay clears its busy notice before publishing the result, so navigation and listeners receive one coherent completed state.
